items.titleEn: Arrighetti tosses 3 2/3 solid innings in Triple-A rehab start
bodyEn: TORONTO -- While the Blue Jays took on the Yankees in their series finale Sunday at Rogers Centre, Spencer Arrighetti was pitching in a rehab game for Triple-A Buffalo.
Arrighetti is on the IL while dealing with Morton’s neuroma in his right foot, a buildup of skin tissue in the foot that impacts the nerves and can cause sharp pain.
This is what you need to know:
How did Arrighetti perform?Arrighetti rolled through the early innings before allowing a two-run homer in the fourth, the only damage against him over 3 2/3 frames on 50 pitches (35 strikes).

On the radar gun, Arrighetti’s four-seamer averaged 90.5 mph, which is noticeably below his average of 92.4 mph this season in the big leagues. Part of that can be chalked up to the adrenaline of a big league game, so it’s not necessarily a cause for worry at this point.

This workload fell right in line with what the Blue Jays had planned on. Now, they’ll need to evaluate how Arrighetti’s foot felt throughout the outing and determine whether it was limiting him on the mound in any way.

What’s next?The context of Toronto’s rotation matters here. Trey Yesavage just underwent left knee surgery to repair his meniscus, and Jameson Taillon is on the IL with right forearm tendinitis, so the Blue Jays are rolling with a bullpen game as their No. 5 starter right now.

Arrighetti doesn’t need to be built up to 90 pitches to be deemed “ready,” he just needs to be able to pitch in a legitimate “bulk” role his first time through as he continues to stretch back out. Normally, he’d still need two more rehab starts, but perhaps only one more is needed. If that pitch count gets up over 60 with less of a dropoff in velocity, that should be enough, but it’s worth monitoring how his velocity in the third or fourth inning compares next time out.

What are they saying?Arrighetti’s move from the Astros was a difficult one, and understandably so. Houston was home for Arrighetti, where his family could catch nearly all of his home games, which he described as a “bubble of supreme comfort” as a young player.

Getting back into the groove of baseball with his teammates can only help, though. And now that we’re back to Arrighetti facing hitters, he’s looking to better control his stuff after walk rates of 5.1 per nine innings in each of the past two seasons.

“The zone is really small now, so I’ve been working on not walking people,” Arrighetti said soon after being traded. “I’m actually taking some really good strides, leaning into the pitches I throw in the zone. That was actually a conversation I had with [the Blue Jays] earlier, just lean into the weapons that made me who I am today. Obviously, I’ve got swing-and-miss stuff. I’m going to lean into that, just being as competitive as possible and suffocating the zone.”
What else?Beyond the 2027 season, the Blue Jays also have club control through ‘28 and ‘29 with Arrighetti, so there’s also a long-term angle to this.

We’ve already seen a bit of this with José Soriano. Any bigger “overhaul” can be saved for next spring down in Dunedin, Fla., but it’s never too early to tinker. The Blue Jays have already moved Soriano back toward his sinker instead of his four-seamer, and there could be some similar arsenal adjustments to keep an eye on early with Arrighetti.
If the Blue Jays can develop Arrighetti into a reliable back-end starter, that’s an excellent trade in exchange for two months of Daulton Varsho.
items.titleZh: Arrighetti 3A康复赛先发3 2/3局表现稳健
items.summaryZh: Arrighetti在3A康复赛先发3 2/3局仅失两分。
bodyZh: 多伦多——周日在罗杰斯中心与洋基的系列赛收官战中，蓝鸟队在场上作战的同时，Spencer Arrighetti正在为3A水牛城队投一场康复赛。
Arrighetti因右脚莫顿神经瘤进入伤病名单，这是一种足部皮肤组织增生，影响神经并可能引起剧痛。
以下是你需要了解的信息：
Arrighetti表现如何？Arrighetti在前几局顺利过关，直到第四局被轰出一支两分本垒打，这是他3 2/3局50球（35个好球）中唯一的失分。
在雷达测速上，Arrighetti的四缝线速球平均时速为90.5英里，明显低于他本赛季在大联盟的92.4英里平均时速。这部分可以归结为大联盟比赛的肾上腺素效应，因此现阶段不一定需要担心。
这一投球量完全符合蓝鸟队的计划。现在，他们需要评估Arrighetti在出赛中脚部的感觉，并判断这是否在投手丘上限制了他的发挥。
下一步是什么？多伦多先发轮值的情况在此很重要。Trey Yesavage刚刚接受左膝半月板手术，Jameson Taillon因右前臂肌腱炎进入伤病名单，因此蓝鸟队目前正以牛棚投手作为第五号先发。
Arrighetti并不需要投到90球才能被视为“准备好”，他只需要能够在首次上场时承担真正的“长局数”角色，同时继续拉长投球量。通常来说，他还需要两次康复赛，但也许只需要一次。如果他的用球数超过60球且球速下降幅度较小，那就应该足够了，但值得关注的是他下次出赛中第三或第四局的球速对比。
他们在说什么？Arrighetti从太空人队交易过来是一个艰难的决定，这完全可以理解。休斯敦是Arrighetti的家，他的家人几乎能观看他所有的主场比赛，他形容这是年轻球员的“极致舒适气泡”。
不过，与队友一起重新进入棒球节奏只会有所帮助。现在Arrighetti再次面对打者，在连续两个赛季每九局保送率均为5.1之后，他期待更好地控制自己的投球。
“好球带现在非常小，所以我一直在努力不保送打者，”Arrighetti在被交易后不久表示。“我实际上正在取得很好的进步，倾向于投进好球带的球。这正是我之前与[蓝鸟队]的一次对话，就是依靠让我成为今天这样的投手的武器。显然，我有挥空三振的能力。我会在这方面下功夫，尽可能保持竞争性，并压制好球带。”
还有什么？除了2027赛季之外，蓝鸟队在'28和'29年对Arrighetti也有球队控制权，因此这也有一个长期角度。
我们已经从José Soriano身上看到了一些这样的迹象。任何更大的“改造”都可以留到明年春季在佛罗里达州达尼丁进行，但提早调整永远不会太早。蓝鸟队已经让Soriano从四缝线速球改回伸卡球，并且Arrighetti早期也可能有一些类似的投球组合调整值得关注。
如果蓝鸟队能将Arrighetti培养成一名可靠的后段先发投手，那么用Daulton Varsho的两个月使用权换来这笔交易就非常出色。

items.titleEn: Electric arm Jays acquired in Hoffman trade flashes potential at High-A
bodyEn: With the chaos of the Trade Deadline in the dust, the Blue Jays are suddenly hurtling back into the American League Wild Card chase.

Meanwhile, on the farm, trade chips are settling into their new affiliates. Dasan Hill, who joined the Blue Jays in the Jeff Hoffman trade with the Twins, made his second start for High-A Vancouver on Saturday night and flashed his tantalizing potential.

In the Canadians’ 5-3 win over Tri-City, Hill went toe-to-toe with Angels No. 21 prospect Mason McGwire, who also changed dugouts at the Deadline. A 6-foot-5 southpaw, Hill matched his second-longest outing of the season by tossing four innings, allowing just one unearned run while striking out three in his new home ballpark, Rogers Field at Nat Bailey Stadium.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »

Now Toronto’s No. 8 prospect, Hill was drafted in 2024 by Minnesota in Competitive Balance Round B (69th overall). Armed with an upper-90s fastball, he made relatively light work of his first pro assignment at Single-A. He posted a 2.77 ERA and .190 batting average against over 52 innings before moving up to High-A last year.

This season has proved more challenging for Hill. Back at High-A, he has still showcased swing-and-miss stuff but paired with additional control problems. At the time of the trade, he had a 5.80 ERA with 37 walks in 45 innings, counterbalancing his 77 strikeouts.

He made progress on that front Saturday, not issuing a free pass. He collected each of his punchouts on a different offering -- breaking ball, changeup, fastball -- and three of his four hits allowed were of the infield variety.

Hill opened eyes during Spring Breakout in March when he hit 100.1 mph on the radar gun, a glimpse into the electric nature of his left arm. Both the Twins and now the Jays have kept an eye on his workload, as Hill has thrown more than 75 pitches just once this season. Refining his command -- as he has through his brief Toronto tenure -- would allow his three above-average-or-better pitches to play up as he makes his way through the system.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟在霍夫曼交易中获得的强力左投手在高级A级展现潜力
items.summaryZh: 达桑·希尔在霍夫曼交易中加盟蓝鸟，周六先发四局仅失一分非自责分。
bodyZh: 随着交易截止日的喧嚣尘埃落定，蓝鸟突然重新杀回美国联盟外卡争夺战。
与此同时，在农场系统中，交易筹码们正在适应新的附属球队。达桑·希尔在明尼苏达双城与蓝鸟的杰夫·霍夫曼交易中加入球队，周六晚上他代表高级A级温哥华加拿大人队先发出场，展现了他令人垂涎的潜力。
在加拿大人队5-3战胜三城队的比赛中，希尔与天使队排名第21的潜力新秀梅森·麦格威尔展开对决，后者也在截止日更换了球队。6英尺5英寸的左投手希尔投了四局，追平了本赛季第二长的出场记录，仅失一分非自责分，同时在新主场罗杰斯球场（纳特贝利球场）送出三次三振。
在您附近购买小联盟比赛门票 »
希尔现在位列蓝鸟潜力新秀第八名，他在2024年选秀中被明尼苏达在竞争平衡B轮（第69顺位）选中。凭借接近100英里/小时的快速球，他在单A级首个职业任务中相对轻松。在去年升上高级A级之前，他在52局中自责分率为2.77，被打击率为.190。
本赛季对希尔来说更具挑战性。回到高级A级，他仍然展示出挥空三振的能力，但伴随更多控制问题。在交易时，他在45局中自责分率为5.80，送出37次保送，同时有77次三振。
周六他在这方面取得了进步，没有送出保送。他的每次三振都使用了不同的球种——变化球、变速球、快速球——他被打出的四支安打中有三支是内野安打。
希尔在3月的春训突破赛中引起关注，当时他的雷达测速达到100.1英里/小时，让人一窥他左臂的爆发力。双城和现在的蓝鸟都在关注他的工作量，本赛季希尔只有一次投球数超过75球。正如他在短暂的多伦多时期所展现的那样，改善他的控球——将能让他的三个高于平均或更好的球种在他逐步晋升的过程中发挥出更大威力。

items.titleEn: After long journey through injuries in Minors, Tiedemann makes his MLB debut
bodyEn: The Blue Jays have called up left-hander Ricky Tiedemann from Triple-A Buffalo to be available for Saturday's game against the Yankees.
The promotion represents the culmination of a long journey for Tiedemann, Toronto's No. 11 prospect, who underwent Tommy John surgery in July 2024 and missed all of the 2025 season.

Selected by the Blue Jays in the third round of the 2021 MLB Draft (and the 91st overall pick), the lefty is 0-1 with a 6.43 ERA this season in seven appearances (two starts) for Buffalo. In his Minor League career, he's recorded a 5-11 record and a 3.18 ERA in 48 games (43 starts) and 147 innings.

Before his elbow injury, Tiedemann was Toronto's No. 1 prospect and the No. 29 prospect in baseball entering the 2024 season. The team has been cautious with his workload this season, but expects him to be a contributor at the big league level.

“Hopefully, he’s a factor for us in our rotation,” GM Ross Atkins told MLB.com last year. “That’s the plan, but we would be open to him impacting the team in a bulk role or some creative way, depending on how things are going.”
In a corresponding move, the Blue Jays optioned right-hander Chase Lee to Triple-A.
items.titleZh: 历经小联盟伤病漫长旅程，Tiedemann迎来MLB首秀
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟队左投Ricky Tiedemann历经伤病，迎来MLB首秀。
bodyZh: 蓝鸟队已将左投手Ricky Tiedemann从三A布法罗队升上大联盟，他有望在周六对阵洋基队的比赛中出场。
此次升上大联盟是Tiedemann漫长旅程的 culmination，他是多伦多排名第11的潜力新秀，于2024年7月接受了汤米·约翰手术，并缺席了整个2025赛季。
这位左投手在2021年MLB选秀第三轮（总第91顺位）被蓝鸟队选中，本赛季为布法罗队出场7次（2次先发），战绩0胜1负，自责分率6.43。在小联盟生涯中，他在48场比赛（43次先发）及147局中取得5胜11负、自责分率3.18的成绩。
在肘部受伤前，Tiedemann是蓝鸟队的头号新秀，进入2024赛季时是棒球界排名第29的新秀。球队本赛季对他的工作量一直很谨慎，但期待他能在MLB层面做出贡献。
“希望他能成为我们先发轮值的一员，”总经理Ross Atkins去年告诉MLB.com，“这是计划，但我们也愿意接受他以长局中继或其他有创意的方式影响球队，这取决于情况进展。”
在相应的人员调整中，蓝鸟队将右投手Chase Lee下放到三A。

items.titleEn: McAdoo channels Vladdy Jr. as Blue Jays continue stunning climb
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Can you believe it? With another win Saturday, the Blue Jays grabbed their share of a crowded, messy tie for the final American League Wild Card spot.

You have the coming weeks to familiarize yourself with MLB’s tiebreaker rules, and both the Twins and Rangers still play later Saturday night, but this captures just how spectacular this recent run has been for the Blue Jays.

Saturday’s 4-1 win over the Yankees is their seventh win in their past nine games, finally making the Blue Jays (61-64) the “hot” team in a Wild Card race that has sat stagnant, waiting for a good story.
This is what mattered most:
1. McAdoo finally delivers the big blowStop me if you’ve heard this one before, but the Blue Jays were stuck in a quiet, low-scoring game waiting for someone to get a big hit. Familiar, isn’t it?

Charles McAdoo changed everything with one swing in the seventh, a rocket double off the wall in center to score the go-ahead run. Just inches shy of clearing the wall for a home run, this looked like one of those classics from Vladimir Guerrero Jr., hit so hard (107.4 mph) that it was either going to go over the wall or through it. McAdoo came right back around in his next at-bat with an RBI single, too, breaking open the Blue Jays’ rally in the eighth.

McAdoo is essentially the “next man up” in Guerrero’s place after the face of the franchise hit the seven-day concussion IL early Saturday. He’ll be in the lineup every day, and with a swing like this in a moment that big, McAdoo looks like he can be more than just a short-term fill-in.

2. Cy Young watch: Schlittler states his caseThe Blue Jays couldn’t get much going against Cam Schlittler, who held them to one run over 5 1/3 innings with seven strikeouts. Chasing Schlittler that early was a small win, though, as they drove up his pitch count with three walks and some deep at-bats despite not making much hard contact.

This outing dropped Schlittler’s ERA a couple of points to 2.19, where he still holds the advantage over Blue Jays ace Dylan Cease (2.40). Cease does hold some advantages when you look at strikeout rates and the advanced metrics, though, so this profiles as a race that will go down to the wire.
Cease will pitch the series finale Sunday against the Yankees, and both pitchers are lined up to pitch again in next weekend’s series between these two teams in The Bronx.

3. Welcome to the show, Ricky TRicky Tiedemann made his big league debut Saturday, the Blue Jays’ former No. 1 prospect finally back after missing nearly two full calendar years rehabbing from Tommy John surgery. Still just 23 years old, Tiedemann is still dripping with talent and upside, so while it’s an awfully bold move by the Blue Jays, it’s still easy to see why they’re going to him after only a handful of appearances in Triple-A.

Tiedemann allowed one run over 1 2/3 innings of work, striking out two. His fastball averaged 96.2 mph and touched 97.2, but you’ll often see him go to his slider or excellent changeup with two strikes like he did Saturday afternoon.

Tiedemann is going to get some legitimate looks over the next week against the Rays and Yankees. He’d been pitching on a stricter schedule in the Minor Leagues, given his rehab, but it’s possible the Blue Jays try to shorten those windows a bit to allow Tiedemann to pitch with just one off-day in between.
items.titleZh: McAdoo展现Vladdy Jr.风采，蓝鸟继续惊人攀升
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟再胜，McAdoo关键安打，Tiedemann首秀，追平外卡席位。
bodyZh: 多伦多——你能相信吗？周六再次取胜后，蓝鸟在美联外卡最后一个席位的混乱并列中抢占了一席之地。
未来几周你有时间熟悉MLB的平分决胜规则，双城和游骑兵周六晚些时候还有比赛，但这已经足以说明蓝鸟近期表现有多么惊艳。
周六4-1战胜洋基，是他们在过去9场比赛中的第7场胜利，终于让蓝鸟（61胜64负）成为外卡争夺战中的“热门”球队，此前这场竞争一直停滞不前，等待一个精彩的故事。
以下是最重要的看点：
1. McAdoo终于打出关键一击——如果你听过这个故事，请打断我。蓝鸟又陷入一场沉闷的低比分比赛，等待有人打出关键安打。熟悉吗？
Charles McAdoo在第七局的一次挥棒改变了局面，他击出一记直击中外野墙的二垒安打，打回超前分。这球距离越过墙成为本垒打只差几英寸，看起来就像Vladimir Guerrero Jr.的经典之作，击球速度高达107.4英里/小时，要么飞过墙，要么撞墙而出。McAdoo在下一个打席又打出一支打点一垒安打，为蓝鸟在第八局的攻势打开了局面。
McAdoo基本上是在Guerrero于周六早些时候因脑震荡进入七天伤病名单后，顶替他的“下一个上阵者”。他将每天出现在先发阵容中，凭借这样关键时刻的表现，McAdoo看起来不仅仅是短期顶替者。
2. 赛扬奖观察：Schlittler证明自己——蓝鸟面对Cam Schlittler没有太多办法，他在5 1/3局中仅失1分并送出7次三振。不过，这么早将他打退也算小胜，因为他们用三次保送和一些消耗性的打席抬高了他的用球数，尽管没有太多强力击球。
这场比赛让Schlittler的自责分率下降了几个点，来到2.19，他仍然领先于蓝鸟王牌Dylan Cease（2.40）。不过，从三振率和进阶数据来看，Cease确实有优势，因此这像是一场会拼到最后的竞争。
Cease将在周日对阵洋基的系列赛收官战中先发，两位投手也预计在下周末两队于布朗克斯的系列赛中再次对决。
3. 欢迎来到大联盟，Ricky——Ricky Tiedemann在周六完成了大联盟首秀，这位蓝鸟昔日的头号新秀在因汤米·约翰手术康复缺席近两个完整日历年之后终于回归。年仅23岁的Tiedemann依然天赋十足、潜力巨大，因此尽管蓝鸟此举相当大胆，但依然不难理解他们为什么在他在3A仅出场几次后就启用他。
Tiedemann在1 2/3局中失1分，送出两次三振。他的速球平均时速96.2英里，最高97.2英里，但你常会看到他在两好球时使用滑球或出色的变速球，就像周六下午那样。
Tiedemann下周对阵光芒和洋基时会有一些正式机会。由于康复原因，他在小联盟期间一直按照更严格的时间表投球，但蓝鸟可能会缩短这些间隔，让Tiedemann在仅休一天的情况下出赛。

items.titleEn: Vlad placed on injured list day after exiting with head injury
bodyEn: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was out of the Blue Jays’ starting lineup Saturday, one day after exiting the game and undergoing concussion protocols.

Guerrero collided with Yankees shortstop George Lombard Jr. in a chaotic play at third base during the sixth inning of Toronto's 3-1 win over New York on Friday. As an errant throw got away from Lombard and he turned to chase after the ball, his left knee hit Guerrero in the face.

“He had a headache last night. I think it’s one of those where the doctors wanted to see how he woke up today,” manager John Schneider said pregame. “He’s here, I think kind of feeling the same. They’re just finishing up testing for today and we’ll go from there.”

No roster move involving Guerrero was announced, but the Blue Jays did recall left-handed pitcher Ricky Tiedemann from Triple-A Buffalo ahead of Saturday's game, optioning righty Chase Lee in a corresponding move. Outfielder Daz Cameron has also reported to the Toronto clubhouse.
Should Guerrero land on the IL, 10-day or the 7-day concussion option, rookie Charles McAdoo would be the primary option to fill in at first base. Third baseman Kazuma Okamoto could also slide over.
items.titleZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 在头部受伤退场次日被列入伤病名单
items.summaryZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 因头部受伤被列入伤病名单，蓝鸟队召回左投手Ricky Tiedemann并调整阵容。
bodyZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 周六未进入蓝鸟队的先发阵容，前一天他退出了比赛并接受了脑震荡检查程序。
周五蓝鸟队以3比1战胜纽约洋基队的比赛中，第六局在三垒出现混乱局面，Guerrero 与洋基队游击手 George Lombard Jr. 相撞。当时 Lombard 的一次传球失误，他转身追球时，左膝撞到了 Guerrero 的脸。
主教练 John Schneider 赛前表示：“他昨晚头疼。我认为这是医生想看看他今天醒来后情况如何的那种情况。他在这里，我觉得感觉差不多。他们今天刚完成测试，我们会继续观察。”
蓝鸟队没有宣布涉及 Guerrero 的阵容调整，但在周六比赛前确实从三A布法罗队召回了左投手 Ricky Tiedemann，并将右投手 Chase Lee 下放作为相应调整。外野手 Daz Cameron 也已向多伦多俱乐部报到。
如果 Guerrero 进入伤病名单（10天或7天脑震荡选项），新秀 Charles McAdoo 将是填补一垒位置的主要选择。三垒手 Kazuma Okamoto 也有可能移防一垒。

items.titleEn: Schlittler, Cease pitch during same series amid Cy Young Award race
bodyEn: TORONTO -- It’s a Cy Young showdown this weekend at Rogers Centre, Dylan Cease versus Cam Schlittler with each of their lineups trying to tear the other guy down.

The AL Cy Young Award has become a two-horse race, and if the season ended today, it’s nothing near unanimous. Schlittler is scheduled to pitch Saturday with Cease throwing in the finale on Sunday, which lines each of them up to pitch in next week’s series (Aug. 21-23) at Yankee Stadium, too.
This is where the race stands and what’s at stake over the next week:
MAKE YOUR CASE:
Cam Schlittler, New York Yankees• 10-6, 2.21 ERA (146.2 IP)• 4.7 WAR (FanGraphs)

The 25-year-old sensation has owned this conversation through the heart of the season, carrying a sub-two ERA into late June. This race is all about the inches, the slight advantages that add up to someone winning by a few votes. Schlittler, at first glance, has the stronger ERA and he’s done it over more innings after Cease spent two weeks on the IL with a hamstring strain.
Schlittler’s strikeout rate (11.2 K/9) is elite for a starter, and while it’s not quite at Cease’s level (13.1), he’s done this with a walk rate that is essentially half of Cease’s.

Remember, this award is voted on by 30 members of the BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association of America) each year. Just like the MVP Award, voters value certain metrics over others, while team success can also bleed into the context. If Schlittler’s Yankees stay hot down the stretch and Cease’s Blue Jays fade, could that shift in the conversation further benefit Schlittler? Besides, he has the numbers to back up his case and is one of baseball’s most entertaining pitchers to watch.
Dylan Cease, Toronto Blue Jays• 7-5, 2.40 ERA (131 1/3 IP)• 4.5 WAR
Cease’s case, here and now, leans more on advanced metrics and overwhelming strikeout numbers. Those are fine arguments, too.

Even after missing a couple of starts, Cease leads the American League in strikeouts (191). Across the Majors, he trails only the strikeout king himself, Jacob Misiorowski (204). Again, we’re talking about small margins here, but Cease’s ceiling has been a few inches higher than Schlittler’s, but Schlittler has a sturdier floor.

So many of their surface-level stats are too close to call, coming down to a matter of style or preference more than anything else. Some of the advanced metrics, like FIP, favor Cease slightly, and if we’d like to get really fine with this argument, Cease has allowed a lower average exit velocity and fewer home runs (14 to nine).
The more we dig, though, the more we see how close these pitchers are, neither of them with one truly undeniable number that overshadows the rest.
SOME HELP FROM THEIR FRIENDS?

Schlittler has handled the Blue Jays just fine this season, allowing just three runs over his 13 innings with 14 strikeouts. The Blue Jays were much tougher on Schlittler a year ago as a rookie, including a start in early September when they chased him after just 1 2/3 innings, but we haven’t seen that version of the Blue Jays much this season.

Cease has faced the Yankees just once in 2026, allowing two runs over four innings of work. With four walks and nine strikeouts, that was a classic Cease outing, flashing dominant stuff but not nearly efficient enough. That’s the blueprint to beating Cease, and while we’re only working with a one-day sample size here, the Yankees have at least pulled it off.
Still, the margins are so tight. If one lineup can hang five runs on the opposing starter and flip the ERA race here, that could go a long way.
TEAM HISTORY
Wouldn’t you have guessed the Yankees had a bigger edge than six Cy Young Awards to the Blue Jays’ five? They’re connected by Roger Clemens, too, who won with each organization.
The Yankees have 25 MVP Awards in their franchise’s deep history, and you may have heard they’ve won the World Series 27 times, but the Cy Young has been more elusive.
Yankees: Gerrit Cole (2003), Roger Clemens (2001), Ron Guidry (1978), Sparkly Lyle (1977), Whitey Ford (1961), Bob Turley (1958)
Blue Jays: Robbie Ray (2021), Roy Halladay (2003), Roger Clemens (1997-’98), Pat Hentgen (1996)
items.titleZh: 赛扬奖竞争白热化，Schlittler与Cease系列赛同场对决
items.summaryZh: 赛扬奖之争进入白热化，Cease与Schlittler本周末同场对决，下周再战。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 本周末罗杰斯中心将上演一场赛扬奖对决，Dylan Cease对阵Cam Schlittler，双方打线都试图击垮对方。
美国联盟赛扬奖已成为两人之争，如果今天赛季结束，结果远非一致。Schlittler计划于周六先发，Cease则在周日收官战中登板，这也让两人有望在下周（8月21-23日）于洋基球场的系列赛中再次对决。
以下是目前竞争形势以及未来一周的关键所在：
各自战绩：
Cam Schlittler，纽约洋基· 10胜6负，自责分率2.21（146.2局）· 胜利贡献值4.7（FanGraphs）
这位25岁的超级新星在赛季中期一直主导着这一话题，直到6月底仍保持低于2的自责分率。这场竞争比拼的是细节，微小的优势累积起来，最终可能以几票之差决出胜负。Schlittler乍一看拥有更出色的自责分率，而且他在更多的局数中做到了这一点，因为Cease曾因腿筋拉伤在伤病名单中待了两周。
Schlittler的三振率（每九局11.2次）在先发投手中属于顶级，虽然还不及Cease的水平（13.1），但他的保送率几乎只有Cease的一半。
请记住，该奖项每年由美国棒球作家协会（BBWAA）的30名成员投票选出。与MVP奖一样，投票者会看重某些数据，而球队的成功也会影响评选。如果Schlittler的洋基队在赛季末段保持火热，而Cease的蓝鸟队状态下滑，这种形势的转变是否会进一步有利于Schlittler？此外，他有数据支撑自己的论点，并且是棒球界最具观赏性的投手之一。
Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟· 7胜5负，自责分率2.40（131又1/3局）· 胜利贡献值4.5
Cease目前的优势更多体现在进阶数据和惊人的三振数上。这些都是有力的论据。
即使缺席了几场先发，Cease仍以191次三振领跑美国联盟。在整个大联盟中，他只落后于三振王Jacob Misiorowski（204次）。再说一次，我们谈论的是微小差距，但Cease的上限比Schlittler略高，而Schlittler的下限更稳固。
他们的许多基础数据太过接近，难以判断，更多是风格或偏好的问题。一些进阶数据，如FIP，略微偏向Cease，如果我们想更细致地比较，Cease的平均出口速度更低，被本垒打也更少（14比9）。
然而，越深入分析，越能看出这两位投手的接近程度，他们都没有一项真正无可争议的数据能够压倒其他方面。
来自队友的助力？
Schlittler本赛季对阵蓝鸟队表现出色，13局仅失3分，送出14次三振。去年作为新秀时，蓝鸟队曾给Schlittler制造了不少麻烦，包括9月初的一次先发，仅让他投了1又2/3局就被打退，但本赛季我们很少看到那样的蓝鸟队。
2026年Cease仅面对过洋基队一次，四局失两分。四次保送和九次三振，这是典型的Cease式比赛，展现出了统治力，但效率不够高。这就是击败Cease的蓝图，虽然我们这里只有一天的样本，但洋基队至少做到了。
尽管如此，差距仍然非常微小。如果某一方打线能对对方先发投手拿下五分，从而扭转自责分率的竞争，那将大有帮助。
球队历史
你是不是以为洋基队会比蓝鸟队有更大的优势？洋基队获得过六次赛扬奖，蓝鸟队五次。两队还因Roger Clemens而联系在一起，他曾效力于两支球队并都赢得了赛扬奖。
洋基队在其悠久的历史中拥有25座MVP奖杯，你可能听说过他们27次赢得世界大赛，但赛扬奖却更难企及。
洋基队：Gerrit Cole（2003）、Roger Clemens（2001）、Ron Guidry（1978）、Sparkly Lyle（1977）、Whitey Ford（1961）、Bob Turley（1958）
蓝鸟队：Robbie Ray（2021）、Roy Halladay（2003）、Roger Clemens（1997-'98）、Pat Hentgen（1996）

items.titleEn: Blue Jays surging up Wild Card standings -- but holding breath over Vladdy
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Things are getting awfully interesting north of the border.

The Blue Jays, who spent much of this season growing stale on the outer edges of the postseason picture, suddenly have as much momentum as any team in the American League Wild Card race. Friday night’s 3-1 win over the Yankees puts Toronto (60-64) just one game back of the final postseason spot with 38 games remaining.
This is what mattered most:

1. Holding their breath: Guerrero injuredVladimir Guerrero Jr. left the game soon after scoring the Blue Jays’ first run in the sixth, a messy play during which he collided with George Lombard Jr. at third base before scoring on the error.

Even with a .693 OPS next to his name, Guerrero is still the player the Blue Jays can least afford to lose because of the upside he still represents. We’re also just three days away from the one-year anniversary of the last time Guerrero hit a regular-season home run at Rogers Centre.

Everyone has a theory, because of course they do. The Blue Jays are stuck on the doorstep of the AL Wild Card race, but if Guerrero were playing anything like he’s capable of, they’d already be sitting comfortably in one of those spots. What else do you expect people to talk about?

“People are always trying to have the right answer,” manager John Schneider said. “All of the things that are out there, some of them are probably close to being right and some of them probably aren’t. There are a lot of theories out there. I think the person who knows his swing the best is Vlad.”

2. Madness on the bases!The Blue Jays have made a habit of staring their opponents down this week and not blinking first. The Red Sox made a handful of crucial errors that flipped games in that four-game series, and Friday night, it was the Yankees’ turn. If the Blue Jays’ offense is going to leave them stuck in low-scoring games, this is the type of airtight baseball they need to be playing.

What looked like an inning-ending double play off the bat of George Springer quickly went wild when the throw to first skipped in front of Luis García Jr., who couldn’t make the scoop. That sent Guerrero racing from second to third -- the play during which he was injured -- and eventually scampering home.

By the time Alejandro Kirk doubled in the go-ahead run, that felt like a footnote on the inning. This feels like the blueprint for the Blue Jays, finding any way to win, regardless of whether it’s beautiful or not.

3. Bieber and the Blue Jays look refreshedFor weeks leading up to the Trade Deadline, Shane Bieber was an obvious trade candidate, given that he was a pending free agent on a disappointing team. The Blue Jays chose to hold onto Bieber, though, and even though he was coming off a rough outing against the Phillies on Sunday, this looked like Bieber at his best with six innings of one-run ball.
Good pitching, clean defense and a scrappy run at the right time. If the Blue Jays can find an identity coming out of their busy Trade Deadline, this is it.

“I felt like we were a little bit stagnant, kind of waiting for someone to do something,” Schneider said. “I do think that it’s removed us from 2025 a little bit, just because of the different people in the building. Every team is different. You can’t force a team to be like the team last year. With some new guys who have some things to prove, that’s rubbed off on everyone who has been here. This is the brand of baseball we’ve been searching for.”
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟外卡排名飙升 但为Vladdy捏把汗
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟胜洋基，距外卡席位仅差1场，Vladimir Guerrero Jr.受伤。
bodyZh: 多伦多——边境以北的局势正变得格外有趣。
蓝鸟队本赛季大部分时间都在季后赛版图的边缘日渐平庸，但突然间，他们在美国联盟外卡争夺战中拥有了与任何球队一样的势头。周五晚上以3-1击败纽约洋基队后，多伦多（60胜64负）仅落后最后一个季后赛席位1个胜场，还剩38场比赛。
以下是本场比赛最重要的方面：
1. 捏把汗：格雷罗受伤。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在第六局为蓝鸟队跑回第一分后不久便退场，这是一个混乱的回合：他在三垒与George Lombard Jr.相撞，随后利用对方失误跑回本垒。
即便他目前OPS只有.693，格雷罗依然是蓝鸟队最输不起的球员，因为他仍代表着球队的上限。另外，再过三天，就是格雷罗上一次在Rogers Centre打出常规赛本垒打的一周年。
每个人都有一种说法，当然如此。蓝鸟队目前就卡在美国联盟外卡争夺战的门口，但如果格雷罗能发挥出他应有的水平，他们本可以稳稳占据其中一个席位。你还指望人们谈论什么呢？
“人们总是试图找到正确答案，”主教练John Schneider表示。“外界的各种说法，有些可能接近真相，有些则未必。理论有很多。我认为最了解他挥棒的人就是Vlad。”
2. 垒上疯狂！蓝鸟队本周已经习惯于与对手对峙，并且从不先眨眼。红袜队在那个四连战中多次出现关键失误，扭转了比赛走势，而周五晚上轮到了洋基队。如果蓝鸟队的进攻让他们陷入低比分比赛，他们就需要打出这种滴水不漏的棒球。
George Springer打出一记看似会以双杀结束半局的球，但传向一垒的球在Luis García Jr.面前弹地，他未能接住。这让格雷罗从二垒冲向三垒——正是在这次跑垒中他受了伤——并最终连跑带跳地回到本垒。
等到Alejandro Kirk打出超前分的二垒安打时，之前的一切都像这一局的注脚。这似乎就是蓝鸟队的蓝图：无论方式是否漂亮，都要想办法赢球。
3. Bieber与蓝鸟焕然一新。在交易截止日前的数周内，Shane Bieber显然是一个交易候选人，因为他是这支令人失望的球队中即将成为自由球员的球员。但蓝鸟队选择留下Bieber，尽管他在周日对阵费城人队的比赛中表现不佳，但这场比赛看起来是Bieber的最佳表现：六局仅失一分。
出色的投球、干净的防守和关键时刻的顽强进攻。如果蓝鸟队能在繁忙的交易截止日后找到自己的定位，这就是他们的定位。
“我觉得我们之前有些停滞，像是在等某个人做点什么，”Schneider表示。“我确实认为这让我们稍微脱离了2025年的轨迹，只是因为更衣室里的人不同了。每支球队都不一样。你不能强迫一支球队变成去年的样子。有些新来的人有想要证明的东西，这种心态也感染了在这里的每个人。这就是我们一直在寻找的棒球风格。”

items.titleEn: Guerrero exits, in concussion protocol after collision on chaotic play
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was removed from Friday night’s game against the Yankees with an apparent injury after colliding with George Lombard Jr. in a chaotic play at third base.

Guerrero actually scored on the play, but it was immediately clear that he was dealing with some discomfort. Manager John Schneider and the Blue Jays’ trainer popped out of the dugout to walk back alongside Guerrero, who was soon removed from the game and replaced by rookie Charles McAdoo.

Guerrero started the play standing on first base, but after a throw across the diamond from Ryan McMahon skipped in front of Luis García Jr., who couldn’t make the scoop, Guerrero broke for third. The throw back across the diamond to third base caught the Yankees without a man on the bag, and as Lombard tried to get there for the throw, he and Guerrero collided awkwardly.
Guerrero has been dealing with back issues throughout the 2026 season. He has also had some hamstring issues flare up, but never to the point where an IL stint has been considered.
Further updates are expected following Friday’s game.

bodyZh: 多伦多——弗拉基米尔·格雷罗二世在周五晚对阵洋基队的比赛中，于三垒一次混乱的冲撞后因伤离场。
格雷罗在该次进攻中实际上跑回了本垒得分，但明显可以看出他有些不适。主教练约翰·施奈德和蓝鸟队的训练师走出休息区，陪同格雷罗走回，随后格雷罗被换下场，由新秀查尔斯·麦卡杜顶替。
格雷罗从一垒开始跑垒，但在瑞安·麦克马洪的传球绕过内野、路易斯·加西亚二世未能接住后，格雷罗冲向三垒。回传三垒的传球让洋基队无人守垒，隆巴德试图赶到接球时，与格雷罗发生了尴尬的碰撞。
格雷罗在整个2026赛季一直受到背部问题困扰，他也有过腿筋问题发作，但从未严重到需要进入伤病名单。

bodyEn: TORONTO -- To appreciate the value of the Blue Jays’ farm system, we need to step back and look at the bigger picture.

Year after year, this front office has shown a willingness to deal top prospects and first-round picks. At this Trade Deadline, it helped them land a potential frontline starter in José Soriano, which cost them a prospect package fronted by No. 2 prospect Arjun Nimmala. A year ago, the Blue Jays dealt several prospects from their top 10 to fuel a World Series run with Louis Varland, Shane Bieber and Seranthony Domínguez.

This isn’t new, either. José Berríos was brought to the Blue Jays from the Twins for a big-time package, too, headlined by Austin Martin. This farm system has improved at steadily producing big league contributors and hit the jackpot with Trey Yesavage a year ago, but Toronto’s player development staff also deserves a great deal of credit for the trade chips they’ve stacked up for their front office.
Outside of the Soriano deal, though, this Deadline was more about selling than buying, which brings some fresh talent back in the other direction.
Here’s a look at where the Blue Jays’ farm system stands after our full midseason re-rank, including all new prospects from the MLB Draft and the Trade Deadline.

An eighth-round pick from the 2025 Draft, Thompson is looking like one of this system’s better development stories, and at 24, he’s putting himself in a very interesting spot with a good stretch at Double-A New Hampshire. Between the two levels this season, Thompson has posted a 3.10 ERA with 112 strikeouts over 90 innings. A strong finish to this season will set Thompson up for a shot at Triple-A in 2027, bringing an opportunity to emerge as a legitimate piece of big league depth.

After starting his season a few weeks late, Hechavarria has put up some inconsistent outings that all add up to a 7.98 ERA with only 46 strikeouts over 58 2/3 innings. bodyZh: 多伦多——要理解蓝鸟农场系统的价值，我们需要退后一步，从更宏观的角度来看待。

年复一年，这支球队的管理层都表现出交易顶级新秀和首轮签的意愿。在本次交易截止日，他们因此得到了潜在的前段先发投手何塞·索里亚诺（José Soriano），代价是由2号新秀阿尔琼·尼玛拉（Arjun Nimmala）领衔的一批新秀。一年前，蓝鸟交易了前十新秀中的数人，换来了路易斯·瓦兰德（Louis Varland）、肖恩·比伯（Shane Bieber）和塞兰托尼·多明格斯（Seranthony Domínguez），以助推世界大赛征程。
这也并非新鲜事。何塞·贝里奥斯（José Berríos）也是从双城交易到蓝鸟的，当时同样付出了以奥斯汀·马丁（Austin Martin）为首的丰厚筹码。这套农场系统已经稳步提升了培养大联盟球员的能力，一年前还靠特雷·耶萨维奇（Trey Yesavage）押中了宝，但多伦多的球员发展团队也因他们为管理层积累的交易筹码而值得称赞。
不过，除了索里亚诺这笔交易，这个截止日更多是在出售而非引进，因此也为球队换回了一些新鲜血液。
以下是在我们进行完整的中期重新排名后，蓝鸟农场系统的状况，其中包含了来自MLB选秀和交易截止日的所有新秀。

items.titleEn: 'We're a full send': Schneider, Blue Jays adopt all-in mentality amid Wild Card race
bodyEn: TORONTO -- There’s something dangerous about 26 ball players with nothing to lose.

Reports of the Blue Jays’ death have been greatly exaggerated. This team is alive again, breathing the oxygen of a depressed AL Wild Card race which has left the door cracked open for them. Which of these other contenders are truly undeniable? Why not the Blue Jays?

This team still needs an offensive outburst and desperately needs Vladimir Guerrero Jr., but these past two weeks have brought better days. Fresh off taking three of four from the Red Sox, the Blue Jays welcome the Yankees to town Friday night, sitting just two games behind the Rangers and Tigers for the final spot in the AL Wild Card race.
“Maybe the baseball gods are changing their minds about us,” manager John Schneider said.

The Blue Jays no longer seem content to leave their fate to the gods, though. That’s how it felt before the Trade Deadline, an organization stuck in the mud and unable to escape the long shadow of their 2025 run to Game 7 of the World Series against the Dodgers. Slowly and steadily, the season kept slipping away, each game feeling too similar to the last.

Something’s changed, though. This is part relief, with the Trade Deadline and its realities now behind the Blue Jays, and part acceptance. Sure, they’d rather be 20 games above .500 and taking another run at the division, but that’s not their current reality. The reality is that they begin a 39-game season Friday night at Rogers Centre against the Yankees, and they need to beat a handful of average AL contenders by a couple of games to make it a successful one. Why not?

“It’s been nice to feel the energy shift over the last week. Not just on the field, but in here with the guys, too,” Schneider said. “The bullpen knows we’re a full send. The lineup knows it’s the same way. We used the whole bench yesterday. We’re just going for it.”

Print the t-shirts now, “Full Send” plastered across a Blue Jays logo. If they can shock the baseball world and sneak into the postseason, you might find one of those shirts or towels draped on your seat in October.

Schneider is the right manager for this exact team in this exact spot. Grip it, rip it, send it and see what happens. If the Blue Jays take big hacks and it doesn’t work? So be it. If they try to take the extra base and get thrown out? Well, they weren’t in a postseason spot to begin with anyway. Throw punches until you hit the ground.
The veterans on this roster know how rare this is, some of them running out of opportunities to chase October. It’s addicting once you’ve tasted it.
“We’re right in this fight,” Max Scherzer said. “We’re in it. This is fun to be in this situation. Every game matters. Every start matters.”

Schneider’s job description feels so much different right now than it did a year ago. He’s batting rookies Charles McAdoo and Brett Bateman in the top two spots regularly, shuffling his lineup daily and trying to drag his struggling superstar, Guerrero, out of a career-worst slump. These are not the days for analytics and lineup optimization. Schneider needs energized, motivated ball players ready to run through a wall.

In the Blue Jays’ dugout, he’s cranked up the speakers connected to the stadium’s sound system. Most of the players didn’t even know those were in there, but suddenly, music is pumping right into the dugout at full volume, anything he can do to wrangle the energy and chaos of this building.
“I love music. It’s like the crowd. You can hear it, but if you can really hear it, that goes under that category of a ‘full send’,” Schneider said. “Like, let’s [freaking] go.”
Maybe that’s another t-shirt in a couple of months, but with a Blue Jays logo covering up a few letters.
This is all sitting right in front of the Blue Jays now. First, they need to survive the Yankees, the Rays and the Yankees once again in New York. After that, though? It’s a dream schedule.

The Blue Jays’ last 30 games, beginning Aug. 25 against the Royals, all come against teams with a record below .500, and many of them are involved in the AL Wild Card race. Every day will be moving day, especially if the Blue Jays can carry this momentum through the next 10 days against their division rivals.
Until then? Send it.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟主帅Schneider：外卡战‘全力冲刺’
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟在美联外卡争夺中状态回升，主帅Schneider表示将‘全力冲刺’，不留退路。
bodyZh: 多伦多——当26名球员一无所有时，他们就是危险的。
关于蓝鸟队死亡的报道被大大夸大了。这支球队再次活了过来，呼吸着美联外卡争夺战的氧气。尽管竞争形势低迷，但大门仍为他们留了一道缝。这些竞争者中，有谁真正不可撼动？为什么不能是蓝鸟队？
这支球队仍然需要进攻爆发，迫切渴求 Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 找回状态，但过去两周已迎来好转。刚从四场对红袜的比赛中拿下三场，蓝鸟队将于周五晚上在主场迎战洋基队，目前在美联外卡争夺中仅落后游骑兵和老虎两个胜场，竞争最后一个席位。
“也许棒球之神正在改变对我们的看法，”主教练 John Schneider 说道。
然而，蓝鸟队似乎不再甘心听天由命。这是交易截止日前的感受：球队深陷泥沼，无法摆脱2025年世界大赛对阵道奇队抢七大战的阴影。赛季在缓慢而稳定地流失，每场比赛都感觉与前一场如出一辙。
不过，还是有所改变。这一部分是解脱，因为交易截止日及其现实已过去；一部分是接受。当然，他们更愿意胜场比负场多20场，再次向分区发起冲击，但这不是他们目前的现实。现实是，他们将从周五晚上在 Rogers Centre 对阵洋基队开始最后39场比赛，需要战胜几支普通的美联竞争者，多赢几场，才能让这个赛季取得成功。为什么不呢？
“过去一周感受到能量的变化真是太好了。不仅是在场上，更衣室里也是一样，”Schneider 说道。“牛棚知道我们要全力冲刺。打线也是一样。昨天我们启用了整个替补席。我们就是要放手一搏。”
现在就可以印制T恤了，蓝鸟队徽上印着‘全力冲刺’字样。如果他们能震惊棒球界并悄然闯入季后赛，你或许会在十月份发现自己的座位上有这样一件T恤或毛巾。
Schneider 正是这支球队在目前处境下的合适主帅。握紧球棒，用力挥击，全力冲刺，然后静观其变。如果蓝鸟队放手一搏却没成功？那就算了。如果他们试图多占一个垒包却被触杀？反正他们本来就不在季后赛席位中。挥拳出击，直至倒下。
阵容中的老将们知道这有多难得，其中有些人追逐季后赛的机会已所剩无几。一旦尝过这种滋味，就会上瘾。
“我们正处在这场战斗之中，”Max Scherzer 说道。“我们身处其中。身处这种局面很有趣。每场比赛都很关键，每次先发都很关键。”
Schneider 现在的工作职责与一年前相比感觉大不相同。他经常让新秀 Charles McAdoo 和 Brett Bateman 打前两棒，每天调整打线，并试图让还在挣扎的超级巨星 Guerrero 走出职业生涯最严重的低潮。现在不是讲究数据分析和优化打线的时候。Schneider 需要精力充沛、动力十足、准备好撞穿一堵墙的球员。
在蓝鸟队的休息区，他调高了连接球场音响系统的扬声器音量。大多数球员甚至不知道那里有扬声器，但突然间，音乐以最大音量涌入休息区，只要能驾驭这座球场的能量和混乱，他什么都愿意做。
“我喜欢音乐。它就像人群一样。你能听到它，但如果你真的听得很清楚，那就属于‘全力冲刺’的范畴了，”Schneider 说道。“就像，我们他妈的冲吧。”
也许几个月后会有另一款T恤，但蓝鸟队徽会遮住几个字母。
现在这一切都摆在蓝鸟队面前。首先，他们需要挺过洋基队、光芒队，然后再次在纽约对阵洋基队。不过之后呢？这是一个梦幻赛程。
蓝鸟队最后30场比赛，从8月25日对阵皇家队开始，对手都是胜率不足五成的球队，其中许多队也参与美联外卡争夺。每一天都将是排位变动日，尤其是如果蓝鸟队能够在接下来10天对阵分区对手时保持这股势头。
在那之前？全力冲刺。

items.titleEn: Five young Blue Jays to watch down the stretch
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson's Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- At this point, the Blue Jays are willing to try anything.

Who predicted lineups with Brett Bateman and Charles McAdoo batting in the top two spots? All that matters is that it works, and as the Blue Jays try to climb the American League Wild Card race, they’ve shown a willingness to hand over more playing time to young players if they’re producing.
Looking ahead to the final six weeks of the regular season, whether it’s a postseason run or Toronto fades from the race, these are the players you could be seeing more of:
OF Brett BatemanRealistic 2027 role: The new Myles Straw

Manager John Schneider clearly likes what he sees in Bateman. His speed-and-contact profile fits in center -- and atop a lineup -- but Bateman isn’t a No. 1 prospect surrounded by hype. There’s a certain amount of “feel” to the decision to roll the club’s No. 20 prospect per MLB Pipeline out there, which is why this is easier to believe in.

“You never know when you’re going to find a dude,” Schneider said. “Again, it’s a handful of games, but he has the potential with both his skills and the way he thinks, the way he can adjust, to be pretty damn good.”

The archetype of a Straw or Nathan Lukes works well here, a role the Blue Jays clearly value. If Bateman can fill that role and turn it up a notch with his speed and defense, there will be some very happy people in this organization.
3B Charles McAdooRealistic 2027 role: Davis Schneider’s 2024-’25 role

McAdoo’s power potential makes him relevant, but the No. 12 prospect’s athleticism and a growing defensive profile make this truly interesting. He’s batting near the top of the lineup on a team trying to make a postseason run, which tells you all you need to know about the staff’s trust in him.

The Schneider role is useful to frame McAdoo, whose defensive profile is third base, second base and left field in a pinch. If McAdoo can become serviceable in left, which Schneider did admirably, then this only gets more interesting. Consider this one of the roles that isn’t exactly a “regular,” but leaves plenty of room to hit your way into the lineup.
LHP Ricky TiedemannRealistic 2027 role: Major League bullpen

Let’s not get too far ahead of ourselves after just three Triple-A rehab appearances, but at the very least, we’re finally back to the point of Tiedemann pitching “regularly,” even if that schedule is still being carefully managed after his long rehab from Tommy John.

Tiedemann (Toronto's No. 10 prospect), who turns only 24 on Tuesday, still feels even younger in prospect years, given how much time he’s missed. The talent is all there, though, and if the Blue Jays can wrangle it -- and keep Tiedemann healthy -- this is a lefty reliever who throws 98 mph with legitimate big-league out pitches. Those don’t grow on trees.

For now, bet on a 95% likelihood that Tiedemann just finishes out this season in Triple-A and enters camp as a must-watch story in the spring. If Toronto falls out of the race, though, he’s already on the 40-man roster and could get a late look.
1B Sean KeysRealistic 2027 role: Competing for bench bat role
Keys’ first taste of the big leagues was a learning experience, but he still has 24 home runs across 96 games this season. That will play.

Keys (Toronto's No. 5 prospect) would need an injury in front of him or the Blue Jays to fall out of contention to see more playing time, but he’ll have more opportunities to force his way into this club’s plans. If he can play a solid third base, that gets much easier, and could open up a role as a righty-mashing role player.
UTIL Jay HarryRealistic 2027 role: Competing for 26th man

One of the breakout stars of the Minor League system, Harry (Toronto's No. 21 prospect) is batting .316 with 13 home runs and a .919 OPS, while playing all over the diamond. This is the exact type of profile that would work well at the end of the big league bench, finding ways into the lineup regularly at multiple positions.

Harry made a swing change coming off a poor 2025 season, primarily in his posture at the plate. The Blue Jays challenged him to crank up his bat speed, which he nailed, and that’s been paired with a serious uptick in aggression at the plate. He’s gone from nearly being forgotten as organizational depth to being a legitimate candidate for playing time in ‘27.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟值得关注的五位年轻球员
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟队重点观察的五位年轻球员，或在赛季末段获得更多机会。
bodyZh: 本文摘自基根·马西森的《蓝鸟击球》通讯。点击此处阅读完整通讯，并订阅以定期在收件箱中获取。
多伦多——现阶段，蓝鸟队愿意尝试一切。
谁能预测布雷特·贝特曼和查尔斯·麦卡杜会出现在前两棒？重要的是这能奏效。在蓝鸟队试图冲击美国联盟外卡席位的过程中，他们表现出只要年轻球员有产出，就愿意给予更多上场时间。
展望常规赛最后六周，无论是冲击季后赛还是多伦多逐渐掉队，以下这些球员可能会获得更多出场机会：
外野手 布雷特·贝特曼现实2027年角色：新一代迈尔斯·斯特劳
主教练约翰·施耐德显然对贝特曼的表现很满意。他速度与接触兼备的风格适合中外野——也能担任开路先锋——但贝特曼并不是备受关注的头号新秀。让MLB Pipeline排名球队第20位的潜力新秀上场，其中有一定“感觉”成分，这正是更容易让人信服的原因。
“你永远不知道什么时候会遇到一个厉害的家伙，”施耐德说。“再说一次，这只是几场比赛，但凭借他的技术、思维方式以及调整能力，他有潜力变得非常出色。”
斯特劳或内森·卢克斯的模板在这里很合适，这也是蓝鸟队显然重视的角色。如果贝特曼能胜任这一角色，并用他的速度和防守更进一步，那么这支球队里会有人非常高兴。
三垒手 查尔斯·麦卡杜现实2027年角色：戴维斯·施耐德2024-25赛季的角色
麦卡杜的打击潜力使他备受关注，但这位排名第12位的潜力新秀的运动能力和日益提升的防守表现让这一切更加有趣。他在一支冲击季后赛的球队中担任前段棒次，这足以说明教练组对他的信任。
用施耐德的角色来定位麦卡杜很合适，他的防守位置包括三垒、二垒以及紧急情况下的左外野。如果麦卡杜能像施耐德那样在左外野表现得可靠，那么前景会更加令人期待。这算作一个并非绝对“固定先发”的角色，但有足够空间让你用打击争取进入先发阵容。
左投手 里基·蒂德曼现实2027年角色：大联盟牛棚
在仅仅三次小联盟复健出场后，我们别太着急，但至少我们终于回到了蒂德曼“规律性”投球的阶段，尽管在接受汤米·约翰手术后的长期复健中，他的赛程仍在被谨慎管理。
蒂德曼（蓝鸟队排名第10位的潜力新秀）周二才满24岁，考虑到他错过的时光，在潜力新秀的年龄里他显得更年轻。但天赋都在，如果蓝鸟队能加以利用——并保持蒂德曼健康——这将是一位能投出98英里速球、并且有真正大联盟级决胜球的左投后援。这可是稀缺资源。
目前来看，蒂德曼有95%的可能性会在本赛季余下时间在小联盟三A度过，并作为春季训练中必须关注的故事进入新赛季。不过，如果多伦多掉出竞争行列，他已经在40人名单上，可能会在赛季末获得出场机会。
一垒手 肖恩·基斯现实2027年角色：竞争替补打击角色
基斯首次体验大联盟是一次学习经历，但他本赛季在96场比赛中仍击出24支本垒打。这会派上用场。
基斯（蓝鸟队排名第5位的潜力新秀）需要身前有人受伤，或者蓝鸟队失去竞争希望，才能获得更多上场时间，但他会有更多机会争取进入球队计划。如果他能稳固防守三垒，那会容易得多，并可能开辟一个专门打击右投的角色。
多功能人 杰伊·哈里现实2027年角色：竞争第26人
作为小联盟体系中的突破之星，哈里（蓝鸟队排名第21位的潜力新秀）打击率达到.316，击出13支本垒打，OPS为.919，同时防守多个位置。这正是适合大联盟替补席末段角色的类型，能以多个位置常规进入先发阵容。
哈里在经历糟糕的2025赛季后改变了挥棒动作，主要是击球姿势。蓝鸟队挑战他提升挥棒速度，他做到了，并伴随着击球积极性的显著提升。他已从几乎被遗忘的组织深度球员，变成2027年上场时间的真正候选人。

items.titleEn: Scherzer becomes second active pitcher to reach 3,000 career innings
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Series by series, the Blue Jays are grinding their way back into the AL Wild Card race.

Thursday’s 7-0 loss to the Red Sox at Rogers Centre was a dud, a tight game up until Chase Lee served up a grand slam to Caleb Durbin to break the game wide open. The 3-1 series win was another step in the right direction, though, for a club that suddenly has built a sense of momentum and sits two games back of the Rangers, who play later Thursday night, for the final AL Wild Card spot.
This is what mattered most from the finale as the Blue Jays look to carry over their winning ways against the Yankees beginning Friday.
1. Mr. 3000 is officially rolling

Max Scherzer became the 139th pitcher in MLB history to pitch 3,000 innings Thursday, another accolade for the future Hall-of-Famer after he moved into 10th place on the all-time strikeouts list just last week. Among active pitchers, only Justin Verlander has thrown more innings (3,571 1/3) than Scherzer.

These past two weeks have been good innings, too. Scherzer is 42 and has battled through forearm, ankle, back and thumb issues this season, but there’s still something left in that tank. If he can do this the rest of the way, it’s major news for the Blue Jays and their injury-riddled rotation.
“I’ll never put anything past Max,” manager John Schneider said. “I’ve kind of just learned to live with that. You never know.”

Scherzer isn’t just pitching for the love of the game at this point, either. He’s a fierce competitor, a two-time World Series champion who came so close to a third ring a year ago. Much like George Springer, his presence alone can help to keep this organization competitive down the stretch. These aren’t the types of players you keep around if you’re just trying to play out the season and get the young guys some reps.

“When he’s pitching and he’s contributing, there’s a different feel to him and the team. He has a little bit of ground to stand on. He lives for this [stuff],” Schneider said with a big grin, which you’ll often see when he talks about Scherzer. “He’s an adrenaline junkie. He lives for this. There’s always a bit of a different emotion with him. I worry about him when he’s done, when he doesn’t have all of this.”
2. Where did the offense go?
Granted, the Blue Jays haven’t been lighting up the scoreboard during their recent run, but in Wednesday’s finale the bats fell completely silent.

Red Sox lefty Payton Tolle put up an extremely unique line, holding the Blue Jays scoreless over eight innings, but he didn’t strike out his first batter until the sixth. Instead, Tolle was a weak contact machine, managing to exploit the Blue Jays’ extreme contact approach to generate plenty of harmless pop flies and ground balls.
3. Vladdy’s glove still works

His bat? That’s another story entirely, and the Blue Jays won’t be able to pull off this postseason run until their franchise player starts hitting like one. Defensively, though, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. looks better than he ever has.
His over-the-shoulder catch on a Willson Contreras pop fly in the sixth inning was the defensive highlight of the game, which left Guerrero tumbling into the netting.

Guerrero is making a fine case for his second career Gold Glove Award this season. The metrics say Guerrero is tied with Paul Goldschmidt of the Yankees for the highest Fielding Run value among AL first basemen (+4). The eye test backs it up, with plenty of highlight-reel plays. Everyone would happily trade this for a few home runs, but Guerrero’s defense can’t be overlooked.
items.titleZh: Scherzer 成为现役第二位生涯投满3000局的投手
items.summaryZh: Scherzer 达成生涯3000局里程碑，蓝鸟系列赛3-1胜红袜，仍落后外卡两场。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟正在一场一场地拼回美联外卡争夺战。
周四在罗杰斯中心0比7负于红袜是一场令人失望的比赛，在 Chase Lee 被 Caleb Durbin 轰出满贯本垒打、比赛彻底失去悬念之前，双方一直打得难解难分。不过，3比1赢下系列赛对这支球队来说又迈出了正确的一步，他们突然积累了势头，目前落后游骑兵两个胜场，后者将在周四晚些时候出战，两队正在争夺最后一个美联外卡席位。
周五开始蓝鸟将对阵洋基，他们希望延续胜利势头，而这正是这场收官战中最值得关注的地方。
1. 3000局先生正式启动
Max Scherzer 周四成为大联盟历史上第139位投出3000局的投手，这是这位未来名人堂成员上周刚升至历史三振榜第10位后的又一项荣誉。现役投手中，只有 Justin Verlander 的投球局数（3571又1/3局）多于 Scherzer。
过去两周，他的投球内容也很出色。Scherzer 已经42岁，本赛季一直与前臂、脚踝、背部和拇指伤病作斗争，但油箱里仍有油。如果他能保持这样的状态到赛季结束，对蓝鸟和伤兵满营的先发轮值来说都是重大利好消息。
“我永远不会低估 Max，”主教练 John Schneider 说道。“我已经慢慢接受了这一点。你永远不知道。”
Scherzer 现在也不只是为了热爱比赛而投球。他是一名斗志昂扬的竞争者，两届世界大赛冠军得主，一年前还险些拿到第三枚戒指。和 George Springer 一样，他光是坐镇队中就能帮助球队在冲刺阶段保持竞争力。如果你只是想混完这个赛季，给年轻球员一些出场机会，你是不会留住这种球员的。
“当他上场投球并做出贡献时，他和整支球队给人的感觉都不一样了。他有点底气。他就为这个而活，”Schneider 咧嘴大笑着说道，每次谈到 Scherzer 时你都会看到他露出这样的笑容。“他是个肾上腺素上瘾者。他为此而生。他身上总是带着一种与众不同的情绪。我担心他退役之后，在没有这一切的时候。”
2. 进攻去哪了？
诚然，蓝鸟在最近一段时期并没有大量得分，但周三的系列赛收官战中，打线彻底熄火。
红袜左投 Payton Tolle 交出了一份非常独特的成绩单，他主投八局没有让蓝鸟得到一分，但直到第六局才三振了首位打者。相反，Tolle 像一个制造软弱击球的机器，他利用蓝鸟极度追求接触的打法，制造了大量无威胁的高飞球和滚地球。
3. Vladdy 的手套依然好使
他的球棒？那完全是另外一回事了。蓝鸟要想完成这次季后赛冲刺，他们的核心球员必须打出应有的打击表现。不过防守端，Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 的表现比以往任何时候都要出色。
第六局他对 Willson Contreras 的高飞球完成了一次过肩接杀，这是全场防守最佳镜头，Guerrero 为此摔进了防护网。
Guerrero 本赛季正在为个人第二座金手套奖而努力。数据显示，Guerrero 与洋基的 Paul Goldschmidt 并列美联一垒手防守跑动值最高（+4）。肉眼观察也印证了这一点，他贡献了大量精彩集锦级别的防守。所有人都愿意拿这种防守去换几支本垒打，但 Guerrero 的防守不容忽视。

items.titleEn: NEW Top 100 and Top 30 Prospects lists are here!
bodyEn: The prospect landscape has changed a lot since we launched our first 2026 Top 100 back in January. After the Draft, a Trade Deadline and the bulk of the 2026 season, we figured it was time to update our rankings.

And it’s not just a new Top 100 we’re unveiling. We’ve given a full refresh of all 30 team’s Top 30 lists, folding in the 2026 Draft class and updating others based on their performances in pro ball this year.
Here’s a breakdown of the updated Top 100:
The Top 10

1. Jesús Made, SS, Brewerss2. Leo De Vries, SS/3B, Athletics3. Franklin Arias, SS, Red Sox4. Eli Willits, SS, Nationals5. Kade Anderson, LHP, Mariners6. Josue De Paula, OF, Dodgers7. Seth Hernandez, RHP, Pirates8. Ryan Sloan, RHP, Mariners9. Sebastian Walcott, SS/3B, Rangers10. Grady Emerson, SS, RaysComplete Top 100 »

The top of the list looks a lot different than it did back before the season began. Konnor Griffin and Kevin McGonigle, the top two prospects, graduated from prospect status, and they were far from alone.

Six of the top 10 have reached the highest level and come off the list (JJ Wetherholt, Nolan McLean, Samuel Basallo and Colt Emerson are the others), with several in contention for Rookie of the Year honors.
Newcomers
Discounting 2026 Draft picks, we’ve added 42 players who weren’t on our preseason Top 100. Some have been added as the season has gone on, some are appearing for the first time.

None of them are higher than Padres catcher Ethan Salas, who is no stranger to the Top 100. The young backstop reached as high as No. 5 on our list, but a combination of stagnant performance and injuries knocked him off of it completely. Still only 20, he’s righted the ship, and then some, performing his way from Double- to Triple-A and now sitting at No. 23 overall.
Here are the 10 highest-ranked newcomers on the midseason list:

23. Ethan Salas, C, Padres27. Luis Hernández, SS/3B, Giants33. Gage Wood, RHP, Phillies36. Christian Zazueta, RHP, Dodgers39. Josiah Hartshorn, OF/1B, Cubs42. Eric Hartman, OF, Braves47. Jhonny Level, SS/2B, Giants49. Anthony Eyanson, RHP, Orioles50. Felnin Celesten, SS, Mariners51. Caden Bodine, C, Rays
Draft debuts

A year ago, we added a dozen members of the Draft Class of 2025 to the Top 100, the same number that was added in 2024. This time around, we’re being a bit more stingy with spots, putting just 10 from the most recent class on the Top 100, though two of them are debuting higher than anyone from last year’s Draft crop did.

10. Grady Emerson, SS, Rays (No. 2 overall pick)11. Roch Cholowsky, SS, White Sox (No. 1)19. Vahn Lackey, C, Twins (No. 3)31. Jackson Flora, RHP, Giants (No. 4)40. Eric Booth Jr., OF, Orioles (No. 7)41. Drew Burress, OF, A’s (No. 8)64. Tyler Bell, SS, Rockies (No. 10)67. Jacob Lombard, SS, Marlins (No. 14)91. Derek Curiel, OF, Pirates (No. 5)97. Gio Rojas, LHP, Rangers (No. 16)
Biggest risers

With 42 newcomers and 10 draftees, that means we have 48 prospects who were on both the preseason list and this update. Of those 52 vacated spots, 34 graduated to the big leagues, led by the top two preseason prospects Konor Griffin and Kevin McGonigle. The remaining 18 fell off the list.

Here are the 10 prospects who made the largest leaps up the list from the preseason, a group led by Dodgers infielder Emil Morales, who has a .919 OPS and 22 homers while playing across two levels of A ball in his age 19 season:

+68: Emil Morales, SS/3B, Dodgers (No. 92 to 24)+64: Theo Gillen, OF, Rays (No. 76 to 12)+57: Ralphy Velazquez, 1B/OF, Guardians (No. 89 to 32)+ 44: Mike Sirota, OF, Dodgers (No. 60 to 16)+ 39: Arjun Nimmala, SS, Angels (No. 77 to 38)+ 37: Angel Genao, SS/3B, Guardians (No. 66 to 29)+ 35: Tyler Bremner, RHP, Angels (No. 81 to 46)+ 31: Caleb Bonemer, 3B/SS, White Sox (No. 61 to 30)+ 28: Franklin Arias, SS, Red Sox (No. 31 to )+ 28: Joshua Baéz, OF, Cardinals (No. 87 to 59)
Demographics

Teams keep growing prospects up the middle. A year ago, a record was set with 30 shortstops on the re-ranked Top 100. That mark didn’t last long. After placing 28 shortstops on the preseason list, we have 33 filling up the rankings now who primarily play the premium position. Our top four, and eight of our top 16, are typically found at short.

Outfielders come next with 27, while pitchers aren’t far behind at 25. That contingent is split 16-9 righties vs. lefties. We have eight catchers, four third basemen, two first baseman and one at second base to round out the list.

It tends to be a Draft-heavy list, and this edition is no different. A total of 68 players came courtesy of the Draft, with the remaining 32 coming via the international market. There are nine countries represented, led by the United States, with 69. The Dominican Republic (12) and Venezuela (10) are next while Canada (3) and Cuba (2) are the other two nations with multiple representatives. The Bahamas, Colombia, Mexico and Spain each have one prospect that was born on its soil.

A dozen players on the list have already changed hands via trade, led by Leo De Vries at No. 2. Zyhir Hope has been dealt twice, and is one of six on this edition of the Top 100 who was traded at this year's Deadline, along with Arjun Nimmala, Anthony Eyanson, River Ryan, Jefferson Rojas and Ramon Marquez.
Farm reports

Our updated farm system rankings are coming soon, but we can take a quick snapshot of which teams have the most high-end talent. There are three organizations with six Top 100 guys each: the Dodgers, Marlins and Mariners. Four teams have five on the list apiece: the Brewers, Giants, Rays and Tigers.

One of the many ways we try to measure the strength of a system is what we call Prospect Points: 100 for the No. 1 prospect, 99 for No. 2 and on down to one point for No. 100. Not surprisingly, the Dodgers lead the way in this category with 417 PP and the Mariners are second (369). The Rays (284), Giants (283) and Tigers (281) are the only other teams over 280 points.
The top 10 organizations in terms of prospect points, with their best prospect in parentheses:

items.summaryZh: 百大新秀榜更新，新秀毕业与新人上榜并存，前十变动明显。
bodyZh: 自从我们一月份首次发布2026年百大新秀榜以来，新秀格局发生了很大变化。经过选秀、交易截止日以及2026赛季的大部分比赛，我们认为现在是更新榜单的时候了。
我们公布的不仅仅是新的百大榜单。我们对全部30支球队的三十大新秀名单进行了全面刷新，纳入了2026年选秀班，并根据今年在职业比赛中的表现更新了其他球员。
以下是更新后的百大榜单解析：
前十名

1. Jesús Made，游击手，酿酒人2. Leo De Vries，游击手/三垒手，运动家3. Franklin Arias，游击手，红袜4. Eli Willits，游击手，国民5. Kade Anderson，左投，水手6. Josue De Paula，外野手，道奇7. Seth Hernandez，右投，海盗8. Ryan Sloan，右投，水手9. Sebastian Walcott，游击手/三垒手，游骑兵10. Grady Emerson，游击手，光芒 查看完整百大榜单 »
榜单前列与赛季开始前相比变化很大。前两位新秀 Konnor Griffin 和 Kevin McGonigle 已经不再具备新秀资格，而且他们并非个例。
前十名中有六人已经升上大联盟并移出榜单（另外四人是 JJ Wetherholt、Nolan McLean、Samuel Basallo 和 Colt Emerson），其中几人在竞争年度最佳新秀奖。
新面孔
除去2026年选秀球员，我们新增了42名未进入季前百大榜单的球员。有些是随着赛季进行而入选，有些则是首次上榜。
其中排名最高的是教士队捕手 Ethan Salas，他对百大榜单并不陌生。这位年轻捕手曾一度升至榜单第五位，但因表现停滞和伤病而完全跌出。如今他年仅20岁，已经重回正轨，甚至超出预期，从2A一路打上3A，目前总排名第23位。
以下是季中榜单上排名最高的十位新人：

23. Ethan Salas，捕手，教士27. Luis Hernández，游击手/三垒手，巨人33. Gage Wood，右投，费城人36. Christian Zazueta，右投，道奇39. Josiah Hartshorn，外野手/一垒手，小熊42. Eric Hartman，外野手，勇士47. Jhonny Level，游击手/二垒手，巨人49. Anthony Eyanson，右投，金莺50. Felnin Celesten，游击手，水手51. Caden Bodine，捕手，光芒
选秀新人
一年前，我们将2025届选秀班的12名成员加入百大榜单，与2024年数量相同。今年我们名额给得更紧，只将最近一届选秀的10人列入百大，但其中两人的首秀排名高于去年任何一位选秀新人。

10. Grady Emerson，游击手，光芒（第2顺位）11. Roch Cholowsky，游击手，白袜（第1顺位）19. Vahn Lackey，捕手，双城（第3顺位）31. Jackson Flora，右投，巨人（第4顺位）40. Eric Booth Jr.，外野手，金莺（第7顺位）41. Drew Burress，外野手，运动家（第8顺位）64. Tyler Bell，游击手，洛矶（第10顺位）67. Jacob Lombard，游击手，马林鱼（第14顺位）91. Derek Curiel，外野手，海盗（第5顺位）97. Gio Rojas，左投，游骑兵（第16顺位）
排名上升最多
加上42名新人和10名选秀球员，我们有48名球员同时出现在季前名单和本次更新中。在52个腾出的名额中，34人升上大联盟，其中包括季前排名前二的 Konor Griffin 和 Kevin McGonigle。其余18人跌出榜单。
以下是从季前榜单上升幅度最大的十位新秀，由道奇队内野手 Emil Morales 领衔，他在19岁时跨两个A级联赛层级，贡献了.919的OPS和22支本垒打：

+68: Emil Morales，游击手/三垒手，道奇（从第92位升至第24位）+64: Theo Gillen，外野手，光芒（从第76位升至第12位）+57: Ralphy Velazquez，一垒手/外野手，守护者（从第89位升至第32位）+44: Mike Sirota，外野手，道奇（从第60位升至第16位）+39: Arjun Nimmala，游击手，天使（从第77位升至第38位）+37: Angel Genao，游击手/三垒手，守护者（从第66位升至第29位）+35: Tyler Bremner，右投，天使（从第81位升至第46位）+31: Caleb Bonemer，三垒手/游击手，白袜（从第61位升至第30位）+28: Franklin Arias，游击手，红袜（从第31位升至 ）+28: Joshua Baéz，外野手，红雀（从第87位升至第59位）
球员构成
各队持续培养中路新秀。一年前，重排的百大榜单中有30名游击手，创下纪录。这一纪录并未保持太久。季前名单上有28名游击手，现在则有33名主要担任这一关键守位的球员进入榜单。我们的前四名和前16名中的八人通常都在游击位置。
外野手以27人紧随其后，投手也有25人。投手阵营右投16人、左投9人。此外还有8名捕手、4名三垒手、2名一垒手和1名二垒手，构成完整榜单。
这份榜单历来以选秀球员为主，本期也不例外。共有68名球员来自选秀，其余32人来自国际球员市场。球员来自9个国家，其中美国以69人居首。多米尼加（12人）和委内瑞拉（10人）紧随其后，加拿大（3人）和古巴（2人）是另外两个有多名代表的国家。巴哈马、哥伦比亚、墨西哥和西班牙各有一名出生于当地的新秀。
榜单上有12名球员已经通过交易换东家，其中排名第二的 Leo De Vries 领衔。Zyhir Hope 已经被交易两次，他是本期百大名单中在本赛季交易截止日被交易的六名球员之一，另外五人分别是 Arjun Nimmala、Anthony Eyanson、River Ryan、Jefferson Rojas 和 Ramon Marquez。
农场报告
我们更新的农场系统排名即将发布，但我们可以先快速了解哪些球队拥有最多顶级天赋。有三支球队各有6名百大新秀：道奇、马林鱼和水手。四支球队各有5人：酿酒人、巨人、光芒和老虎。
我们衡量一个系统实力的方法之一是所谓的“新秀积分”：第1名新秀得100分，第2名得99分，依此类推，第100名得1分。毫不意外，道奇以417分领跑，水手以369分位居第二。光芒（284）、巨人（283）和老虎（281）是另外三支超过280分的球队。

items.titleEn: How much did Dylan Cease’s original painting sell for?
bodyEn: Dylan Cease is known for his work on the mound, having started the All-Star Game for the American League and being among the leaders in the AL Cy Young race. But for one lucky fan, they’ll know Cease from his artwork.

As part of the Sportsnet Jays Care Broadcast Auction, one of Cease’s original paintings sold for $16,000 on Wednesday to support Jays Care, the charitable arm of the Toronto Blue Jays. Toronto’s ace created a piece that represents the city with a large T in the middle and a stream of color surrounding it.

Cease has painted multiple pieces throughout the season as a passion project to go along with his stellar 2.40 ERA on the mound. Shared to his Instagram page, some works of art include the city at night, a Canada Day tribute and a flower-filled piece that sits in manager John Schneider’s office. Cease will even use his talents for the occasional troll of fans.

Cease’s artwork was the third-highest item sold in the auction, trailing a Rawling Glove Chair for $16,750 and a RUSH Guitar Personalized by Geddy Lee for $24,000. Other sharp items and experiences sold included a golf outing with a Blue Jays Alumnus, a date night on the Rogers Centre outfield grass, a Buck Martinez Memorabilia Package and many more.

items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟王牌Dylan Cease的原创画作在慈善拍卖中以16,000美元成交。
bodyZh: Dylan Cease以投手丘上的表现闻名，他曾在全明星赛上为美国联盟先发，并在美联赛扬奖竞争中名列前茅。但对于一位幸运球迷来说，他们会通过Cease的艺术作品认识他。
作为Sportsnet Jays Care广播拍卖的一部分，Cease的一幅原创画作周三以16,000美元成交，用以支持多伦多蓝鸟的慈善部门Jays Care。多伦多的王牌投手创作了一件代表城市作品，中间有一个大写的T，周围环绕着色彩流。
Cease本赛季创作了多幅作品，作为他的热情项目，同时他在投手丘上表现出色，自责分率仅2.40。这些画作分享在他的Instagram页面上，包括城市夜景、加拿大日致敬，以及一幅挂在经理John Schneider办公室里的花艺作品。Cease甚至会用他的才华偶尔跟球迷开玩笑。
Cease的作品是拍卖中第三高的物品，仅次于以16,750美元成交的Rawling手套椅和以24,000美元成交的Geddy Lee签名的RUSH吉他。其他售出的精美物品和体验包括与蓝鸟校友打高尔夫、在Rogers中心外场草地上的约会之夜、Buck Martinez纪念品套装等等。

items.titleEn: Contenders' aces fill up latest SP Power Rankings
bodyEn: Just about six weeks remain in the regular season, so the stretch run is upon us as teams jockey for playoff position. And many of the sport’s top arms will have a big say in how the standings shake out.

Case in point: Each of our top 10 in this latest edition of the Starting Pitcher Power Rankings plies his trade for a team that is at least hanging around the edges of the postseason hunt -- if not right in the thick of it. (In fact, that’s true of virtually every pitcher who received votes.) The aces who finish strong -- through the dog days of August and a stressful September -- will not only solidify their teams’ place in the standings but perhaps also burnish their own Cy Young Award credentials.
Here are the latest Starting Pitcher Power Rankings. (All stats are through Tuesday’s games, unless otherwise noted.)

1. Jacob Misiorowski, Brewers (Last poll: 1)The Miz has been difficult to knock from this perch. That’s what happens when you are sporting a 1.76 ERA and already have cleared the 200-strikeout mark by mid-August. Just one of the many ridiculous Misiorowski stats to watch: his .147 batting average allowed. The single-season record for a qualified pitcher (excluding 2020) is .167 by Pedro Martinez in 2000, when the Hall of Famer was at the very peak of his formidable powers.

2. Dylan Cease, Blue Jays (3)Cease swaps places with the Yankees’ Cam Schlittler from our last poll two weeks ago, though by an extremely thin margin. That feels appropriate, given the two pitchers’ neck-and-neck race for the AL Cy. Cease has thrown about 15 fewer innings due to a brief stint on the injured list early this season, but otherwise, their stat lines are virtually indistinguishable from each other. Cease has certainly made a charge over the past several weeks, posting a 1.31 ERA in seven starts since July 1.

3. Cam Schlittler, Yankees (2)Schlittler isn’t making this easy on Cease, however. On Sunday against the Braves, he was brilliant again, striking out 11, walking none and allowing just one run over seven innings. He still leads the AL with a 2.21 ERA. The interesting thing to watch will be how Schlittler holds up the rest of the way in his first full MLB season. In 2025, he threw 164 innings between the Minors and Majors (including postseason); he’s now at 146 2/3 in 2026.

4. Chris Sale, Braves (6)Think back to when Sale, heading into his age-35 season and facing huge questions about his health and performance, came to Atlanta in a straight-up swap for infielder Vaughn Grissom at the end of 2023. Less than three years later, he’s doing some of the best pitching in the history of a franchise that has seen quite a bit of that. Sale’s 175 ERA+ since the trade is easily the highest for a starter with 400-plus innings for the Braves. Next up: Hall of Famer Greg Maddux at 163 (in about five times as many starts, of course).

5. Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Dodgers (5)Yamamoto is scheduled to face the Brewers on Friday, and Milwaukee can’t be looking forward to that -- not just because Yamamoto has a 2.65 ERA and 0.89 WHIP this season. On May 24, Yamamoto went into Milwaukee and allowed just one run over seven innings in a Dodgers victory. And then, of course, there was their previous encounter, last October, when Yamamoto authored a complete-game victory at American Family Field in Game 2 of the NLCS.

6. Drew Rasmussen, Rays (not ranked)Rasmussen entered Wednesday’s start against the A’s in West Sacramento having spun three straight scoreless outings, totaling 20 innings. In that time, opponents went 7-for-65 against him (.108) with just one extra-base hit, four walks and 27 strikeouts. Rasmussen owns a 2.20 ERA and 2.27 FIP in 11 starts since the beginning of June, and after receiving a bit of Cy Young support for the first time last year (finishing ninth), he looks like a strong contender to show up on a lot of ballots in 2026.

7. Cristopher Sánchez, Phillies (8)On Tuesday night, the Phillies lost a Sánchez start for only the seventh time all season and only the fourth time in his past 19 outings since April 30. It wasn’t his fault, though. Sánchez blanked the Cardinals for six innings, allowing only four singles, two of which were erased on ground-ball double plays. Since a nine-run hiccup on July 6 at Kansas City, Sánchez is back to doing what he’s been doing all year, with a 2.29 ERA in six starts.

8. Gavin Williams, Guardians (not ranked)Before striking out “just” seven against the White Sox on Saturday, Williams had a monstrous five-start streak of double-digit strikeout performances from July 9-Aug. 2, resulting in a total of 55 K’s and just three walks. The five previous pitchers to have at least 55 K’s and no more than three BB’s over five straight starts within a season? Check out this list: Justin Verlander (2019), Clayton Kershaw (2016), Corey Kluber (2015), Curt Schilling (2002) and Pedro Martinez (1999).

9. Jesús Luzardo, Phillies (7)When the Marlins traded Luzardo to the Phillies during the 2024-25 offseason, the lefty was coming off an injury-marred season in which he posted a 5.00 ERA in just 12 starts. Then Luzardo went to Philly, added a sweeper to his repertoire and the rest is history. That may be oversimplifying, but this much is true: Luzardo’s sweeper is now by far his most-used pitch (38.1%), and batters simply cannot touch it (.122 BA, .181 SLG, 49.1% whiff rate). Luzardo’s 107 K’s on the sweeper are the most on any individual pitch type this season, aside from Misiorowski’s four-seam fastball. The sweeper’s plus-17 run value is tied for fifth in the Majors.

10. Troy Melton, Tigers (not ranked)As MLB.com’s Theo DeRosa put it recently: “Tarik Skubal and Casey Mize have been traded. Jack Flaherty and Justin Verlander are on the injured list. The Tigers’ rotation needs a hero, and Detroit might have found one.” Mind you, that was before Melton’s two most recent starts, both Tigers victories, in which Melton tossed a combined 13 innings without allowing an earned run. While the 25-year-old righty missed the first two months of this season with right elbow inflammation, his 1.46 ERA through 13 starts is the lowest in the Majors for anyone with at least 70 innings pitched.
items.titleZh: 竞争者王牌投手占据最新先发投手实力榜
items.summaryZh: 最新先发投手实力榜出炉，酿酒人的Misiorowski居首，蓝鸟的Cease紧随其后。
bodyZh: 常规赛大约还剩六周，各队为季后赛席位展开争夺，冲刺阶段已经来临。而联盟中众多顶级投手将对排名走势产生重要影响。
以本期先发投手实力榜前十名为例，他们所在的球队至少都在季后赛边缘徘徊，甚至正深陷争夺战。（事实上，几乎所有获得选票的投手都是如此。）那些在八月酷暑和紧张的九月结束时依然强势的王牌投手，不仅将巩固球队在积分榜上的位置，还可能为自己增添赛扬奖的砝码。
以下是最新先发投手实力榜。（所有数据均截至周二比赛结束，除非另有说明。）

1. Jacob Misiorowski，酿酒人（上期排名：1）“The Miz”很难被从榜首拉下马。这就是当你拥有1.76的自责分率并且在八月中旬就已突破200次三振时会发生的事情。Misiorowski众多惊人数据中值得一提的一项：他被安打率仅为.147。合格投手的单赛季纪录（不包括2020赛季）是Pedro Martinez在2000年创下的.167，当时这位名人堂成员正处于其强大能力的巅峰。
2. Dylan Cease，蓝鸟（上期排名：3）Cease与洋基队的Cam Schlittler互换了位置，尽管差距极小——后者在上期榜单中排名第二。考虑到两位投手正在美国联盟赛扬奖的竞争中并驾齐驱，这似乎是合理的。Cease因本赛季初短暂进入伤病名单而少投了约15局，但除此之外，他们的数据几乎无法区分。Cease在最近几周确实发起冲击，自7月1日以来的七场先发中自责分率仅为1.31。

3. Cam Schlittler，洋基（上期排名：2）然而，Schlittler并没有让Cease轻松。周日对阵勇士队的比赛中，他再次表现出色，七局飚出11次三振，没有保送，只失一分。他仍以2.21的自责分率领先美国联盟。值得关注的是Schlittler在个人首个完整大联盟赛季剩余时间里的表现。2025年，他在小联盟和大联盟合计投了164局（包括季后赛）；2026年目前已经投了146又2/3局。

4. Chris Sale，勇士（上期排名：6）回想一下，当Sale在2023年底以直接交易换来内野手Vaughn Grissom来到亚特兰大时，他正进入35岁赛季，并面临关于健康和状态的巨大疑问。不到三年后，他正在做出这支球队历史上见过的最好的投球表现。自交易以来，Sale的自责分率调整值（ERA+）为175，轻松成为勇士队史先发投手400局以上的最高值。接下来是名人堂成员Greg Maddux的163（当然，他的先发场次大约是Sale的五倍）。

5. Yoshinobu Yamamoto，道奇（上期排名：5）Yamamoto计划于周五对阵酿酒人队，密尔沃基肯定不希望看到这一点——不仅因为Yamamoto本赛季有2.65的自责分率和0.89的每局被上垒率（WHIP）。5月24日，Yamamoto在密尔沃基投了七局仅失一分，帮助道奇取胜。当然还有他们上一次的交手：去年十月，Yamamoto在美国家庭球场进行的国联冠军系列赛第二场中投出完投胜。

6. Drew Rasmussen，光芒（未上榜）Rasmussen在周三于西萨克拉门托对阵运动家的比赛前，已经连续三场先发未失分，合计投了20局。在此期间，对手对他65个打数仅击出7支安打（打击率.108），只有一支长打，四次保送，并吞下27次三振。自六月初以来的11场先发中，Rasmussen的自责分率为2.20，FIP（独立防守投球指数）为2.27。去年他首次获得一些赛扬奖支持（最终排名第九），而2026年他看起来会成为许多选票上的有力竞争者。
7. Cristopher Sánchez，费城人（上期排名：8）周二晚上，费城人输掉了Sánchez本赛季第七场先发，也是他自4月30日以来最近19场比赛中的第四场失利。不过这并不是他的错。Sánchez对红雀队六局无失分，只让对手击出四支一垒安打，其中两支被双杀打化解。自从7月6日在堪萨斯城失九分的波折后，Sánchez重新回到他本赛季一贯的状态，近六场先发自责分率为2.29。

8. Gavin Williams，守护者（未上榜）在周六对阵白袜队时“只”投出七次三振之前，Williams从7月9日到8月2日经历了连续五场先发三振数上双的恐怖表现，合计贡献55次三振，仅三次保送。在过去，有谁曾在单赛季连续五场先发中至少三振55次且保送不超过三次？看看这份名单：Justin Verlander（2019）、Clayton Kershaw（2016）、Corey Kluber（2015）、Curt Schilling（2002）和Pedro Martinez（1999）。

9. Jesús Luzardo，费城人（上期排名：7）当马林鱼在2024-25休赛期将Luzardo交易到费城人时，这位左投刚刚经历了一个伤病缠身的赛季，12场先发自责分率高达5.00。随后Luzardo去了费城，在他的投球武器库中加入了一颗扫荡球（sweeper），接下来的事情已成为历史。这也许过于简化了，但有一点是确凿的：Luzardo的扫荡球目前是他使用最多的球种（占38.1%），打者根本碰不到（被打击率.122，长打率.181，挥空率49.1%）。Luzardo用扫荡球制造了107次三振，是本赛季所有单独球种中最多的，仅次于Misiorowski的四缝线速球。扫荡球的跑分价值为+17，在大联盟并列第五。

10. Troy Melton，老虎（未上榜）正如MLB.com的Theo DeRosa最近所说：“Tarik Skubal和Casey Mize已被交易。Jack Flaherty和Justin Verlander在伤病名单上。老虎队的先发轮值需要一个英雄，而底特律可能已经找到了一个。”注意，那是在Melton最近两场先发之前说的，这两场老虎都赢了，Melton合计投了13局，没有让对手得到自责分。尽管这位25岁的右投手因右肘发炎缺席了本赛季前两个月，但他13场先发的自责分率1.46是大联盟所有至少投了70局的投手中最低的。

items.titleEn: Eighth-inning rally provides support for Soriano's stellar home debut
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays have outlasted the Red Sox again, staring them in the eye and refusing to blink first.

Wednesday’s 6-4 win was another act of strategic stubbornness, sticking around until the Red Sox cracked. That crack came in the bottom of the eighth, when Willson Contreras dropped a simple pop fly in foul territory, and Kazuma Okamoto made him pay for it on the very next pitch. That’s when the Blue Jays finally kicked the door down.

“I was given another chance right there,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima. “I was able to regroup. I wanted to at least move the runners over, so I was glad I got the big hit right there.”
Toronto has now taken the first three games of this series from the Red Sox, setting up a shot for the sweep tomorrow. The momentum is no longer quietly building, it’s here.
“Maybe the baseball gods are changing their minds about us after about 10 months,” manager John Schneider said.
This is what mattered most:
1. An eruption in the eighth

After Contreras dropped that Okamoto pop fly in foul territory, just behind home plate, the Japanese slugger ripped the next pitch he saw into left field to bring home the go-ahead run. Vladimir Guerrero Jr., diving for home plate on the dramatic slide, looked as energized as he has all season.

A bases-loaded walk from Ernie Clement and a sac fly RBI from pinch-hitter George Springer chipped away, but the big blow finally came from Myles Straw with a two-run double into the gap. Straw has been playing some great baseball lately, and this is exactly what this lineup needs, contributions all the way from one to nine.
Forget five runs in an inning, this team has spent much of 2026 grinding to score five runs in a game. That was the loudest we’ve heard Rogers Centre in a long time.
“There are some young guys bringing some energy and some guys who have some things to prove,” Schneider said. “That rubs off on everyone. It’s a good feeling right now.”
2. José Soriano shines in home debut

This is the version of Soriano the Blue Jays bet on when they sent the Angels a package headlined by No. 2 prospect Arjun Nimmala at the Trade Deadline. Dylan Cease is still the ace of the staff, which is how it’s going to be for years to come, but Soriano could be a legitimate No. 2 starter in a strong rotation, capable of winning games all on his own. Wednesday’s six innings of one-run ball were a glimpse of that.
“That was incredible,” Soriano said after his home debut. “It was incredible, those fans. I came here to do my best.”

Consider this to be "Phase 1" of the Blue Jays’ work with Soriano. You’ll see some surface-level adjustments that are easy to pull off on the fly, like an uptick in his sinker usage and a downtick in his four-seamer usage. The Blue Jays also believe that their catchers will offer Soriano significant help, and all of the data backs that up with Alejandro Kirk and Brandon Valenzuela grading out much stronger than the catchers Soriano worked with on the Angels.
“He’s got a really slow heartbeat,” Schneider said. “He was really good, in control and he’s already taken to what we’ve talked about, just trying to get his stuff in the zone. He did that.”

Next spring, Soriano and the Blue Jays can step back and work on some fine details or tinker with his delivery. For now, Soriano is just fine, and they’ll need him to pitch just like this if they have any hope of a Wild Card run in the American League.
3. Still seeking: Power

This isn’t the first time you’ve read this. The Blue Jays need to hit for more power, and until they do that, the margins will remain incredibly thin. That’s why, even with this recent stretch and some newfound momentum, every day feels like a stressful, one-run battle.
The Blue Jays make a ton of contact… but they hit a lot of singles.

“If you had nine guys who could run like [Brett] Bateman, it’s probably a really good thing,” Schneider said. "There probably needs to be a little bit more of a blend of extra-base hits there. That’s been a big difference. I don’t want to compare last year to this year, but it’s been a big difference where you can generate some offense quickly. Singles are great… when they’re coupled with some doubles or homers.”
items.titleZh: 第八局反扑助索里亚诺主场首秀闪耀
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟第八局爆发击败红袜，索里亚诺主场首秀6局失1分。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟再次比红袜更持久，他们直视对手，拒绝先眨眼。
周三的6-4胜利是又一次战术性的固执表现，他们一直坚持到红袜崩盘。崩盘发生在第八局下半，当时Willson Contreras在界外区漏接了一个简单的冲天球，Kazuma Okamoto在下一球就让他付出了代价。那一刻，蓝鸟终于踢开了大门。
“我在那里得到了另一次机会，”Okamoto通过翻译Yusuke Oshima说道。“我能够重新调整。我想至少把跑者推进，所以我很高兴我在那里打出了关键一击。”
多伦多现在已经从红袜手中赢下了这个系列赛的前三场，为明天的横扫创造了机会。势头不再是悄然积蓄，它已经到来了。
“也许棒球之神在约10个月后开始改变对我们的看法，”经理John Schneider说。
以下是最重要的部分：
1. 第八局爆发
在Contreras漏接Okamoto在界外区、本垒板后方那个高飞球之后，这位日本重炮手将他看到的下一球抽向左边外野，打回超前分。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.以一个戏剧性的滑垒动作飞扑本垒，看起来比本赛季任何时候都更有活力。
Ernie Clement的一次满垒保送和代打George Springer的一支高飞牺牲打贡献了分数，但重击终于来自Myles Straw，他打出一支两分打点的二垒安打打向空当。Straw最近打得非常棒，而这正是这套打线所需要的——从第一棒到第九棒都有贡献。
忘了单局五分吧，这支球队在2026年的大部分时间里都在挣扎着单场拿到五分。那是我们很长一段时间以来在Rogers Centre听到的最响亮的欢呼。
“有些年轻球员带来了能量，有些球员有些东西需要证明，”Schneider说。“这感染了所有人。现在感觉很好。”
2. José Soriano主场首秀闪耀
这就是蓝鸟在交易截止日将以二号潜力新秀Arjun Nimmala为首的一揽子交易送往天使时，所押注的那个Soriano。Dylan Cease仍然是球队的王牌，未来几年也是如此，但Soriano在实力强劲的轮值中可以成为一位名副其实的二号先发，能够靠自己赢球。周三的6局失1分正是那前景的一瞥。
“那真是不可思议，”Soriano在他的主场首秀后说。“那些球迷令人难以置信。我来这里是为了尽我所能。”
把这视为蓝鸟对Soriano改造的“第一阶段”。你会看到一些表面层次的调整，而这些调整很容易在比赛中实施，比如增加伸卡球的使用率，减少四缝线快速球的使用率。蓝鸟还相信他们的捕手会给Soriano带来巨大帮助，而所有数据都支持这一点，Alejandro Kirk和Brandon Valenzuela的防守评级远高于Soriano在天使时搭档的捕手。
“他的心跳非常慢，”Schneider说。“他表现非常好，完全在掌控之中，而且他已经接受我们讨论的内容，那就是尝试把他的球路投进好球带。他做到了。”
明年春天，Soriano和蓝鸟可以退一步来打磨一些细节，或调整他的投球动作。目前，Soriano状态正好，如果他们想在“美国联盟”的外卡争夺中保有希望，就需要他继续这样的投球。
3. 仍待追逐：长打火力
这不是你第一次读到这个了。蓝鸟需要打出更多的长打，而在此之前，比赛的胜负将始终非常微妙。这就是为什么，即使近期状态不错且有些新势头，每一天都像是一场紧张的一分差之战。
蓝鸟能够频繁击中球……但他们打出了太多的一垒安打。
“如果你有九个像[Brett] Bateman那样能跑的人，那可能真的是件好事，”Schneider说。“可能需要有更多一点的长打来平衡一下。那是一个巨大的差距。我不想将去年与今年比较，但这是一个巨大的差距，尤其是在快速得分方面。一垒安打很好……当它们与二垒安打或本垒打结合在一起时。”

items.titleEn: Blue Jays claim Sewald off waivers to bolster weary bullpen
bodyEn: The Toronto Blue Jays claimed right-hander Paul Sewald off waivers from the Arizona Diamondbacks on Wednesday.

Sewald, 36, has appeared in 45 contests for the Diamondbacks this season, posting a 6.23 ERA with a 1.10 WHIP, a .228 opponent average, a 5.5% walk rate, and a 27.0% strikeout rate, while ranking T-4th in the NL in saves (24). The right-hander from Las Vegas, Nev., was selected by the New York Mets in the 10th round of the 2012 First-Year Player Draft out of the University of San Diego, making his MLB debut with the club in 2017. Over 10 MLB seasons, Sewald has suited up for the Mets, Mariners, Diamondbacks, Guardians, and Tigers, appearing in 426 games, posting a 4.30 ERA with a 1.14 WHIP, a .220 opponent average, a 7.8% walk rate, a 28.4% strikeout rate, and 110 saves.
Additionally, right-hander Jake Bloss has been recalled to the Major League roster and placed on the 60-day injured list.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟签下塞瓦尔德补强疲弱牛棚
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟从自由球员市场签下右投保罗·塞瓦尔德以补强牛棚。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟周三从小联盟自由球员市场签下右投保罗·塞瓦尔德，以补强疲弱的牛棚。

现年36岁的塞瓦尔德本赛季为亚利桑那响尾蛇出战45场，自责分率6.23，WHIP 1.10，对手打击率.228，保送率5.5%，三振率27.0%，在国家联盟救援成功次数上并列第4（24次）。这位拉斯维加斯出生的右投手在2012年选秀第10轮被纽约大都会选中，2017年完成大联盟首秀。在10个大联盟赛季中，他曾效力于大都会、水手、响尾蛇、守护者和老虎，出战426场，自责分率4.30，WHIP 1.14，对手打击率.220，保送率7.8%，三振率28.4%，累计110次救援成功。
此外，右投杰克·布洛斯已被召回大联盟名单，并放入60天伤病名单。
